model: EasyIO FC-20 Controller (fixed BACnet object register)
applies_to: The EasyIO FC-20 controller: its 12 universal inputs, 12 digital inputs, 4 analog outputs and 4 digital outputs, plus fixed value registers and I/O configuration objects.
summary: The FC-20 register lists the fixed BACnet objects the controller serves: 12 universal inputs (AI 1-12), 12 digital inputs (BI 1-12), 4 analog and 4 digital outputs, 64 analog value registers and 32 binary value registers for passing data to and from the program, and configuration objects for each input and output (signal type, scaling, offset, temperature table, digital on/off levels, linear and reverse settings, output interlock delays). What the registers mean depends on the program loaded in the controller.
notes: AVIS/AVIF (AV 1-32) and BI Reg (BV 2-17) are read-only registers; AVOS/AVOF (AV 33-64) and BO Reg (BV 18-33) are writable. Their meaning is set by the controller program.
The register shows multistate objects as MSV; they are listed here as MV. The change log says the multistate objects became read/write in January 2015.
The UI scaling, offset and DI level AVs are marked read only in the register, while the TempTable, AO scaling and DO delay AVs are read/write.
The register does not state the BACnet transport or device instance.
The register is published by EasyIO on the Johnson Controls documentation site.

integration.summary: Set each universal input type (MV 1-12) and analog output type (MV 13-16) to match the wiring, then read the inputs (AI 1-12, BI 1-12) and command the outputs (AO 1-4, BO 1-4) or exchange data with the program through the AV and BV registers.

minimum_points.name: AVOS 1
minimum_points.why: First writable analog register to the program

minimum_points.name: BO Reg 1
minimum_points.why: First writable binary register to the program

minimum_points.name: AVIS 1
minimum_points.why: First read-only analog register from the program

setup: UI n Type (MV 1-12): 1 = 0-10 V, 2 = 0-5 V, 3 = 0-20 mA, 4 = 4-20 mA, 5 = resistance, 6 = temperature sensor.
AO n Type (MV 13-16): 1 = voltage, 2 = 0-20 mA, 3 = 4-20 mA.
gotchas: When a program in the controller drives an output, a BMS write to that output may be overwritten.
The AV/BV registers carry no fixed meaning; get the program's point map from whoever wrote it.
